user_reported_bug: Keep the existing categories and their content like before, like the way they were when they are extracted by Apify and remove those empty categories
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused backend verification passed on the Apify-only catalog restore flow: /api/categories returned exactly the 10 canonical Apify slugs with no exotic/empty categories, every canonical category browsed with listings and matching primary category fields, secondary_categories were cleared in sampled listings, admin restore was auth-guarded and idempotent over two calls, admin sync status returned sync_running:false, and the default marketplace feed remained populated.
critical_code_review_comments: Inspected /app/backend/server.py around POST /api/admin/catalog/restore-apify-only and require_admin; the endpoint clears secondary_categories, removes orphan/exotic/empty categories, returns final_counts, and is protected by admin auth.

Runtime evidence after two restore calls showed both calls returned 200; the second call returned secondary_categories_cleared=0, orphan_listings_deleted=0, exotic_categories_dropped=[], exotic_listings_deleted=0, empty_categories_removed=[], and identical total_active_listings=1179.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing preview catalog data and required admin/regular credentials only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not invoke POST /api/admin/listings/rebalance while validating this bug; it can re-add cross-category padding. Current verified final_counts from restore endpoint: women 13, men 69, kids 78, electronics 515, home 155, beauty 108, sports 97, toys 51, books 52, handmade 41; total_active_listings 1179.
rca_of_the_issue: Verification focused on the reported Apify catalog restoration bug. Reproduction checks confirmed no exotic category slugs remain in /api/categories, no sampled listing has secondary_categories, all canonical categories still contain listings, and repeated restore calls are no-ops once clean.
